items.title: Clarence "Little Dad" Vincent Interview, 1959-11-17
items.q: Who was in Charlie Tolles' band? Oh, me. ... Charlie Tolles had his band. ... he just had to grab anybody he could get to go. So, he got I-Ted and my-Ted got me.

ctx.x: Oh, we didn't get her by Charlie Tolles' band. Who was in Charlie Tolles' band? Who was in Charlie Tolles' band?

Who was in Charlie Tolles' band? Oh, me. At the age. And a fella named, this fella I'll tell you about Moran. And a fella named Johnson. And see, he had his wife playing piano. And a fella playing Clowness named Johnson. So, we, we killed a rotten band over there. You see, it wasn't our fault. Charlie Tolles had his band. And when they said he was going to Mexico, well, his band backed out. And he just had to grab anybody he could get to go. So, he got I-Ted and my-Ted got me. And then my-Ted got the, uh, the…
Ask him who danced the Charleston. Who danced it? Yeah, over there in Mexico.
